titulo.alumno: Lesson 7: food and the meals of the day

palabras.significado: can; to have the chance to

texto: Topic: more food and drink, eating in a restaurant, flavours and «already / not yet».
In this part: **food, how things are cooked, flavours, «cho» (to give) and «dùng để»**.
**gạo** is raw rice (the kind you buy) and **cơm** cooked rice (the kind you eat). **ăn cơm** (literally «to eat rice») simply means «to eat».
Meat is said **thịt** + animal: **thịt gà** (chicken), **thịt bò** (beef), **thịt heo** (pork; in the north, **thịt lợn**).

The cooking method goes **after**, like an adjective: **thịt heo nướng** = grilled pork, **gà hấp gừng** = steamed chicken with ginger, **rau muống xào tỏi** = stir-fried rau muống with garlic, **khoai tây chiên** = fried potatoes.

piezas.titulo: Phrases to talk · Meals of the day

frases.estudio: Tôi ăn sáng lúc bảy giờ: cà phê và bánh mì.
frases.alumno: I have breakfast at seven: coffee and bread.

frases.estudio: Tôi ăn trưa lúc một giờ rưỡi, thường ăn cơm với rau.
frases.alumno: I have lunch at half past one; usually rice with vegetables.

frases.estudio: Tối tôi ăn trứng chiên, hoặc sữa chua nếu về muộn.
frases.alumno: For dinner I have fried eggs, or a yoghurt if I get back late.

frases.estudio: Bữa trưa là bữa quan trọng nhất với tôi.
frases.alumno: Lunch is the most important meal for me.

frases.estudio: Con xin thêm ít cơm ạ.
frases.alumno: A little more rice, please (to the in-laws).

nota: note: You can call your partner's mother «mẹ». This compliment always goes down well.

opciones.texto: gạo is raw rice; cơm, cooked rice.

opciones.explicacion: gạo is raw; cơm is cooked.
«no» in Vietnamese is not a negation: it means full.

pregunta.texto: Listen and choose what you hear.

opciones.explicacion: Have you already made the food, Mum?
